    Sending a request does not mean a sample has been ordered or is being shipped. The sample type and scope are discussed for your project.

    01

    Reference samples

    Use a reference to discuss structure, materials or finishing. Availability needs to be confirmed.

    Project-specific samples

    Decide whether to assess the structure, product fit or printed content before agreeing on a sample scope.

    03

    Sample arrangements

    HotPrint will discuss and confirm quantities, costs, receipt options and timing individually.
